channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: UMN professor allegedly conducted ‘ICE drill’ in class, had students shield ‘targeted’ peers: report
item.description: A University of Minnesota professor, Blanca Caldas, reportedly conducted an "ICE drill" in her class where students were instructed to shield peers perceived as targets during a mock scenario involving ICE agents. Some students felt uncomfortable with the exercise, questioning its racial implications, while the university is currently reviewing the situation.

item.title: UNL delivers 50 termination notices amid budgets cuts, chancellor’s contested $1.1M payout
item.description: Bennett's decision came after a no-confidence vote from the UNL faculty senate, whose members have said they felt the cuts by Bennett were especially bitter given his big payout.

item.title: Half of Gen Z brings parents to job interviews: survey
item.description: A January survey revealed that over 50% of college-age job seekers had their parents attend interviews, with many parents also performing tasks like writing cover letters.

item.title: Cal Poly fires chemistry lecturer after raising concerns about foreign hires
item.description: She raised concerns about foreign workers and lab safety. Then the school declined to rehire her.

item.title: Harvard faculty propose capping A grades to combat inflation
item.description: Students have said they are against the proposal.

item.title: Haverford College bans 2 from campus after disrupting Jewish journalist’s talk
item.description: Haverford College in Philadelphia banned two individuals from campus following the disruption of a Jewish journalist's talk. The college confirmed that neither were affiliated with the institution.

item.title: ‘Anti-gay prejudice’ increasing among young people, Northwestern professors say
item.description: Younger generations are less 'pro-gay,' than older generations, Northwestern professors say. Experts say there is more to the story.

item.title: Notre Dame defends decision to appoint pro-choice scholar to leadership post
item.description: Embattled professor told The Fix she is 'fully committed to maintaining an environment of academic freedom where a plurality of voices can flourish.'

item.title: U. Kentucky staff say DEI, ‘antiracism’ are still ‘important’ in undercover videos
item.description: The University of Kentucky says it is compliant with a state ban on diversity, equity, and inclusion after undercover videos of two staffers suggest DEI teachings continue.
